author: Dominic-Madori Davis

title: What startups want from OpenAI
description: Marc Manara, OpenAI’s head of startups, says the reality of AI has advanced far beyond ideas and experiments. AI-native companies are hitting $200 million in annual recurring revenue, and product cycles have shrunk from two-week sprints to single days. And OpenAI is helping. Today on TechCrunch’s Equity podcast, Russell Brandom sits down with Manara at TechCrunch Disrupt 2025 […]
author: Theresa Loconsolo, Russell Brandom

title: AI data startup WisdomAI has raised another $50M, led by Kleiner, Nvidia
description: WisdomAI is offering AI-driven data analytics that can answer business questions from structured, unstructured, and even “dirty” data, meaning data not cleaned of typos or errors.
author: Julie Bort

title: Anthropic announces $50 billion data center plan
description: Anthropic has launched an ambitious new data center partnership with the UK-based Fluidstack, committing $50 billion to building facilities across the US.

title: The global race for the AI app layer is still on
description: The U.S. is far ahead of Europe in the race for large AI models, at least in funding. But the picture is different for the application layer, global VC firm Accel highlighted in its 2025 Globalscape report.
